pretreatment: heated to 1200 K for 300 s to remove all hydroxyl species
evidence: The y-alumina substrate for all experiments was "aluminum oxide C" (Degussa AG, Frankfurt, Germany) with an as-received surface area of 100 m2/g, and an average particle diameter of 20 nm. The powder was pressed into a tantalum mesh which served as a resistive heater.
